en: Sepia-toned photograph of an ornate Baroque or Renaissance-style arched gateway in a stuccoed building, framed as a vintage postcard with scalloped edges. The stone portal is richly decorated with scrollwork, medallions, and a sculpted face above the arch. A heavy metal door with diamond panels stands partly open, revealing a cobbled passage and another arched doorway with double doors in the background. The foreground shows a gravel courtyard.
